hema: quick sync re: triton vs cutlass attention kernels — we need a clear 'gatekeeper' plan for runtime to pick kernels safely. :eyes:
liam: agreed. can we land decision criteria this week? I can drive some microbenchmarks.
hema: want two things: (1) an interface boundary so runtime can swap impls at callsites, (2) a rollout + fallback policy when a kernel regresses.
toni: what do we mean by interface boundary? thin adapter? ABI?
hema: thin adapter. minimal public surface: compute_attn(q,k,v,meta) + can_query_capabilities(). no runtime allocs inside the adapter. keep serialization simple.
liam: ok. rough perf harness I used:
```
# run small-loop perf
python perf/run_attn.py --model=llama7b --seq=512 --bs=1 --impl=triton --iters=200
python perf/run_attn.py --impl=cutlass --quant=fp16
```
results attached in the perf doc but tl;dr: Triton faster on short seqs, CUTLASS wins long seqs on A100.
oliver: CI/infra question: will we compile CUTLASS kernels into the runtime container? binary size + build time might blow up.
hema: proposal: host CUTLASS artifacts as pre-built images per gpu-arch, and runtime pulls matching image. Triton stays Python/Triton source in wheel for fast iterate.
liam: fallback policy suggestion: runtime policy table: preferred->secondary->generic. if preferred fails or regresses beyond 5% p50 latency, auto-fallback for 5 minutes then telemetry alert.
toni: maintenance cost: who owns CUTLASS updates? I propose infra team builds images but eng-ml owns kernel tests/benchmarks.
oliver: infra ok with build pipeline but need a stable manifest file that maps kernel image tags to runtime versions and supported compute capability.
devops-bot: perf-checker: nightly job updated (perf/attn-nightly) — will post CSV to s3://redwood-ci/attn/perf.csv at 03:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
hema: action items: 1) document adapter interface (hema) 2) add CI gating job that runs p50/p95 smoke across seqs 64/256/1024 (liam + toni) 3) infra pipeline for CUTLASS images + manifest (oliver) 4) implement fallback policy + telemetry alert (liam).
liam: I'll open PRs for the harness + gating job today.
toni: I'll sketch the adapter RFC and include example shims for both impls.
oliver: I'll start the image pipeline ticket and add manifest schema.
hema: sweet. if anyone sees a perf regression after rollout, tag me and we'll canary-revert. :thumbsup:
liam: ack.
toni: ack.
devops-bot: ticket created: CI-7892 (attn nightly coverage)
hema: leaving this thread open for any immediate blockers, otherwise I'll merge the adapter RFC draft by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
